verdict.rationale: The public pricing page/pricing.txt discloses specific add-on costs (dedicated IPs threshold, DMARC monitoring at $14/month, custom activity retention at $5/month, unlimited/5 custom sending domains) without requiring a sales call, indicating self-serve pricing transparency. However, evidence does not show explicit volume-tier pricing breakdowns or per-email overage rates beyond plan tiers, so the story's full scope (tiers + overage + add-ons) is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit per-volume tier pricing table and overage rate details beyond add-on costs, independent confirmation that no sales call is ever required for enterprise/dedicated IP volumes.
